name: Sema
description:
Sema adds a content-addressed vocabulary of 452 cognitive patterns to Claude. Each pattern has a handle like StateLock#5602 — a SHA-256 hash of its definition — so two agents using the same handle are provably talking about the same thing. Any divergence in meaning produces a different hash, making silent misalignment impossible.

Key features:

- sema_search — semantic + keyword search across the pattern library
• sema_resolve — full definition, mechanism, invariants, and dependency graph for any handle
• sema_handshake — verify two agents share the exact same definition; halt on mismatch
• sema_tree — browse the taxonomy (Physics / Mind / Society / Infrastructure)
• sema_root — one-hash fingerprint of the whole vocabulary, for fast drift checks
• sema_mint — add project-local patterns (survives pip upgrades)
• sema pull — sync a project DB with upstream, auto-redirecting renamed handles
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **2 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (4): `sema-mint` (How to mint new sema patterns — the full pipeline from concept to content-addressed vocabulary entry), `sema-seed` (Seed the sema vocabulary by exploring random words), `sema-ui` (Launch the Sema web UI at localhost:3030 — interactive pattern browser with 3D graph, search, and live updates), `sema-usage` (Content-addressed vocabulary protocol via the sema MCP server)
- **Hooks** (2): `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`
- **MCP servers** (1): `sema`

Installs with `claude plugin install sema@claude-community` from `emergent-wisdom/sema`.
